title: Modern JavaScript on Node 24: Fundamentals that Ship
concept: Learn the JavaScript every frontend, backend and QA engineer relies on: values and equality, arrays and objects, closures, ES modules, iterator helpers and Set methods, dates and time zones, errors and tests, each taught from a real bug.
description: A beginner course for people who can write a little code and want to write JavaScript that works the first time in production. Every lesson starts from a small, real incident - a cart total of 0.30000000000000004, a duplicated order that silently edits the original, a loop that logs the same id five times, a report that shows yesterday for users in Hanoi, an error that lost its cause - and fixes it with modern JavaScript (ES2025) on Node 24: strict equality, immutable updates with structuredClone, closures, ES modules, iterator helpers and Set methods, Intl date formatting, error causes and node:test.

lessons.title: Arrays & objects: map, filter, reduce & structuredClone
ES modules in Node 24: import, export & top-level await
Iterator helpers & the new Set methods (ES2025)
Dates & time zones: UTC, Intl.DateTimeFormat & day boundaries
Errors that explain themselves: cause, AggregateError & boundaries
